Vacío soloa primera vista.

El Desierto Líbico ocupa dos tercios de Egipto, del Mediterráneo al Gilf Kebir. Sus seis grandes oasis están habitados desde antes de los faraones y todos fueron paradas de las rutas de caravanas hacia África.

SiwaLagos salados, manantiales y el oráculo de Amón
BahariyaPuerta de entrada al Desierto Negro y al Blanco

DajlaAldeas de adobe y fuentes termales
KhargaTemplo de Hibis, fuertes romanos y El-Bagawat

La tribu Al-Rashaida

Los que nuncapierden el rumbo.

Somos hijos de Al-Rashaida, portadores de una historia de honor y responsabilidad, y nos enorgullece haber sido guías del desierto y guardianes de sus caminos durante siglos.

El camino de la tribu
  1. Desde siempre

    Guardianes de las caravanas

    Desde tiempos inmemoriales, la tribu Al-Rashaida se estableció en los oasis de Egipto, donde su nombre estuvo ligado a la protección de las caravanas procedentes de Libia y al cuidado de los peregrinos que atravesaban las rutas del desierto.

  2. Gran Mar de Arena

    Leer la arena

    A través del Gran Mar de Arena, de paisajes similares y difíciles de distinguir, el hombre rashaida destacó por su experiencia única, capaz de guiar las caravanas entre arenas profundas sin perder el rumbo.

  3. 1950 – 1960

    Los primeros asentamientos

    Los primeros asentamientos de la tribu en los oasis de Egipto.

  4. 1982

    Abu Monqar

    El asentamiento en Abu Monqar, el oasis donde hoy se levanta Sand Gate Camp.

El desierto nos impuso un modo de vida singular, que se reflejó en nuestra vestimenta, nuestra comida, nuestras bebidas y nuestras artes, un legado heredado de nuestros ancestros.

¡Bienvenidos!¡Marhaba!

Sand Gate Camp está en el pequeño oasis de Abu Monkar, en el extremo occidental del Desierto Líbico: un caravasar de tierra y madera de palmera, pensado para descansar entre los oasis y las dunas.

Un caravasarpara viajeros de hoy.

La construcción empezó en 2009, con los métodos tradicionales de los oasis. El campamento ocupa una parcela de 5.000 m² rodeada de unas 80 hectáreas de palmerales y árboles frutales.

Su distribución sigue la de los antiguos caravasares que acogían a los viajeros en las rutas del desierto: estancias alrededor de patios en sombra, gruesos muros de tierra que frenan el calor y terrazas abiertas al horizonte. Materiales locales y un interior cálido y minimalista.

Es nuestra base para atravesar el desierto: el lugar donde las expediciones descansan, se reorganizan y vuelven a salir hacia el Gran Mar de Arena.

Espacios queguardan la sombra.

Cada rincón del campamento está hecho al ritmo del desierto: fresco a mediodía, abierto al atardecer y en silencio por la noche.

El DesiertoLíbico.

El Desierto Occidental de Egipto, también llamado Desierto Líbico, ocupa cerca de dos tercios del país: del Mediterráneo al norte hasta el Gilf Kebir al sur, e incluye el Gran Mar de Arena.

Vacío soloa primera vista.

Al oeste del valle del Nilo, en la frontera con Libia y Sudán, se extiende uno de los lugares más secos del planeta. Desde la carretera parece vacío. Recorrido despacio, revela una geografía muy variada y una larga historia humana.

Seis grandes oasis, Siwa, Bahariya, Farafra, Dajla, Kharga y Fayoum, están habitados desde antes de la época faraónica. Fueron las paradas de las rutas de caravanas que unían el valle del Nilo con el corazón de África.

Seis oasis,un desierto.

Cada oasis de nuestras rutas tiene su agua, sus pueblos y sus ruinas.

Grandesexploradores.

Tres hombres que abrieron rutas, trazaron los primeros mapas fiables y desvelaron los secretos del Sáhara egipcio y libio.

I1889 – 1946

Ahmed Hassanein Bey

Explorador, diplomático, fotógrafo y escritor egipcio. Nacido en El Cairo y formado en Oxford.

En 1923 cruzó el Desierto Líbico desde Siwa hasta Kufra, cartografiando zonas del Sáhara libio que nunca se habían trazado. Publicó sus hallazgos en The Geographical Journal y National Geographic.

Más tarde fue jefe de la Casa Real egipcia y consejero del rey Faruq.

II1874 – 1932

Príncipe Kamal el Dine Hussein

Miembro de la familia real egipcia, apasionado de la arqueología y la geografía del desierto.

Entre 1920 y 1924 financió y dirigió expediciones por el Sáhara que dieron lugar a algunos de los primeros mapas precisos del Desierto Líbico.

Fue mecenas de exploradores y de la Sociedad Geográfica de Egipto.

III1895 – 1951

László Almásy

Explorador, aviador y aventurero húngaro, inspiración de El paciente inglés.

Desde los años treinta exploró el Sáhara oriental en coche y en avioneta, y descubrió la Cueva de los Nadadores en el Gilf Kebir, con sus pinturas prehistóricas.

Durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial sirvió al Eje en el norte de África como piloto y agente de inteligencia.

Ciencia, aventuray diplomacia.

Entre los tres abrieron rutas, elaboraron mapas y revelaron los secretos del Sáhara egipcio y libio. Su legado es la razón por la que hoy se puede seguir su rastro.

Varias de nuestras rutas cruzan los paisajes que ellos describieron. Pregúntanos por itinerarios inspirados en sus expediciones.

Darbel-Arba'in.

El Camino de los Cuarenta Días: el tiempo que tardaba una caravana en ir de Darfur al valle del Nilo en Asiut. Durante más de mil años llevó comercio y cultura a través del desierto.

SignificadoCamino de 40 días
DesdeDarfur
HastaAsiut, valle del Nilo
LongitudMás de 1.700 km
En usoMás de 1.000 años
I

Una ruta entre oasis

En época faraónica y romana, la ruta se dividía en Kharga y seguía por los oasis del Desierto Líbico hacia la costa.

II

Más de 1.700 kilómetros

Atravesaba el desierto de Nubia y el Sáhara oriental. Del sur llegaban oro, marfil, goma arábiga y personas esclavizadas; del norte, grano, lino y sal.

III

Restos romanos y bizantinos

Pozos, fortalezas, paradas con inscripciones y torres de vigilancia jalonaban el camino. Algunas ruinas, como las de Kharga, siguen en pie.

La vida enla caravana.

Caravanas de cientos de camellos, guiadas por nómadas expertos, se enfrentaban a tormentas de arena, calor extremo y la búsqueda constante de agua.

Cientos de camellos

Largas filas avanzando al paso, unas decenas de kilómetros al día.

Guías nómadas

Orientación por las estrellas, las dunas y la memoria, transmitida de generación en generación.

Un puente entre mundos

Mercancías, lenguas, religiones y culturas circulaban entre África y Egipto. Faraones, romanos y gobernantes árabes la usaron y mantuvieron.

Hoy las dunas cubren gran parte del trazado, pero sigue viva en la memoria local y en las ruinas que marcan su camino. Varias de ellas las verás en nuestra expedición Cairo – Kharga.

Inicio / Desierto / Oasis históricos

Oasishistóricos.

Kharga es el mayor de los seis grandes oasis del Desierto Occidental, a unos 600 km al suroeste de El Cairo. Durante milenios fue una parada clave entre el valle del Nilo y el África subsahariana.

OasisKharga
Desde El Cairo≈ 600 km
TemplosHibis, Ghueita, Zayyan
NecrópolisEl-Bagawat
HistoriaMás de 4.000 años
I

Fortalezas del desierto

Desde época romana, Kharga se convirtió en una frontera estratégica. Se construyeron fuertes militares para proteger las rutas comerciales y vigilar a las tribus del desierto: Qasr el-Labeka, Qasr el-Zayyan y Om el-Dabadib.

II

Templos del oasis

El templo de Hibis, dedicado a Amón-Ra, es el único templo de época persa conservado íntegro en Egipto. Romanos y coptos lo ampliaron después. Cerca se alzan Qasr el-Ghueita y Qasr el-Zayyan.

III

Necrópolis y tumbas olvidadas

El-Bagawat es uno de los cementerios cristianos más antiguos del mundo, con más de 260 capillas funerarias pintadas.

IV

Civilizaciones a través del tiempo

Las culturas faraónica, persa, griega, romana y copta dejaron aquí su huella. Más de 4.000 años de historia en un solo oasis.

Asíse hizo.

Un homenaje a las personas que construyeron Sand Gate Camp: a mano, con tierra, desde 2009, en el pequeño oasis de Abu Monkar.

Un caravasarmoderno.

La construcción empezó en 2009 en Abu Monkar, un pequeño oasis del Desierto Occidental de Egipto. La idea era un caravasar moderno: un lugar de descanso para los viajeros entre Farafra y Dajla, y una puerta al Gran Mar de Arena.

Se levantó siguiendo los métodos de construcción con tierra del arquitecto egipcio Hassan Fathy, adaptados al clima y al terreno del lugar: muros gruesos, bóvedas y cúpulas que mantienen fresco el interior sin máquinas.

Mirael vídeo.

Tierra, palmeray paciencia.

Lo que hace que el campamento funcione en el desierto.

Muros gruesos y patios en sombra que conservan el fresco de la noche.

Levantado por la gente del oasis, con materiales del lugar.

The Al-Rashaida tribe

Those who neverlose their way.

We are the children of Al-Rashaida, bearers of a history of honour and responsibility, and we are proud to have been guides of the desert and guardians of its paths for centuries.

The path of the tribe
  1. Since time immemorial

    Guardians of the caravans

    Since time immemorial, the Al-Rashaida tribe settled in the oases of Egypt, where its name was bound to the protection of the caravans coming from Libya and to the care of the pilgrims crossing the desert routes.

  2. Great Sand Sea

    Reading the sand

    Across the Great Sand Sea, where every landscape looks alike and is hard to tell apart, the Rashaida man stood out for his unique experience, able to guide caravans through deep sands without ever losing his way.

  3. 1950 – 1960

    The first settlements

    The tribe's first settlements in the oases of Egypt.

  4. 1982

    Abu Monqar

    The settlement in Abu Monqar, the oasis where Sand Gate Camp stands today.

The desert gave us a unique way of life, reflected in our clothing, our food, our drinks and our arts, a legacy inherited from our ancestors.

The LibyanDesert.

Egypt’s Western Desert — the Libyan Desert — covers about two-thirds of the country, from the Mediterranean in the north to the Gilf Kebir in the south, and holds the Great Sand Sea.

Only emptyat first sight.

West of the Nile valley, bordering Libya and Sudan, lies one of the driest places on earth. Seen from the road it looks empty. Travelled slowly, it reveals a rich geography and a long human history.

Six great oases — Siwa, Bahariya, Farafra, Dakhla, Kharga and Fayoum — have been inhabited since before the pharaonic period. They were the stopping points of the caravan routes that linked the Nile valley with the heart of Africa.

Six oases,one desert.

Each oasis on our routes has its own water, its own villages and its own ruins.

Home / The Desert / Great explorers

Greatexplorers.

Three men who opened routes, drew the first reliable maps and uncovered the secrets of the Egyptian and Libyan Sahara.

I1889 – 1946

Ahmed Hassanein Bey

Egyptian explorer, diplomat, photographer and writer. Born in Cairo and educated at Oxford.

In 1923 he crossed the Libyan Desert from Siwa to Kufra and beyond, mapping parts of the Libyan Sahara that had never been charted. He published his findings in The Geographical Journal and National Geographic.

He later became head of the Egyptian Royal Household and an adviser to King Farouk.

II1874 – 1932

Prince Kamal el Dine Hussein

A member of the Egyptian royal family with a passion for archaeology and desert geography.

Between 1920 and 1924 he financed and led expeditions into the Sahara that produced some of the first accurate maps of the Libyan Desert.

He was a patron of explorers and of the Egyptian Geographical Society.

III1895 – 1951

László Almásy

Hungarian explorer, pilot and adventurer, and the inspiration for The English Patient.

From the 1930s he explored the eastern Sahara by car and by plane, and discovered the Cave of Swimmers in the Gilf Kebir, with its prehistoric paintings.

During the Second World War he served the Axis in North Africa as a pilot and intelligence agent.

Science, adventureand diplomacy.

Between them, these three men opened routes, produced maps and revealed the secrets of the Egyptian and Libyan Sahara. Their legacy is the reason travellers can follow their tracks today.

Several of our routes cross the landscapes they described. Ask us about itineraries inspired by their expeditions.

Darbel-Arba'in.

The Forty Days Road: the time it took a caravan to cross from Darfur to the Nile valley at Asyut. For more than a thousand years it carried trade and culture across the desert.

MeaningRoad of forty days
FromDarfur
ToAsyut, Nile valley
LengthOver 1,700 km
In use1,000+ years
I

A road through the oases

In the Pharaonic and Roman periods the route divided at Kharga and continued through the oases of the Libyan Desert towards the coast.

II

Over 1,700 kilometres

It crossed the Nubian desert and the eastern Sahara. From the south came gold, ivory, gum arabic — and enslaved people. From the north, grain, flax and salt.

III

Roman and Byzantine remains

Wells, fortresses, rest stops with inscriptions and watchtowers lined the road. Some ruins, such as those at Kharga, still stand.

Life inthe caravan.

Caravans of hundreds of camels, led by experienced nomad guides, faced sandstorms, extreme heat and the constant search for water.

Hundreds of camels

Long lines moving at walking pace, a few dozen kilometres a day.

Nomad guides

Navigation by stars, dunes and memory, passed down through generations.

A bridge between worlds

Goods, languages, religions and cultures moved between Africa and Egypt. Pharaohs, Romans and Arab rulers all used and maintained it.

Today the dunes cover much of the route, but it lives on in local memory and in the ruins that mark its path — several of which you will see on our Cairo – Kharga expedition.

Home / The Desert / Historic oases

Historicoases.

Kharga is the largest of the six great oases of the Western Desert, about 600 km south-west of Cairo. For millennia it was a key stop between the Nile valley and sub-Saharan Africa.

OasisKharga
From Cairo≈ 600 km
TemplesHibis, Ghueita, Zayyan
NecropolisEl-Bagawat
History4,000+ years
I

Desert fortresses

From the Roman period Kharga became a strategic frontier. Military forts were built to protect the trade routes and watch the desert tribes: Qasr el-Labeka, Qasr el-Zayyan and Om el-Dabadib.

II

Temples of the oasis

The Temple of Hibis, dedicated to Amun-Ra, is the only temple of the Persian period in Egypt preserved intact. Romans and Copts later extended it. Nearby stand Qasr el-Ghueita and Qasr el-Zayyan.

III

Necropolises and forgotten tombs

El-Bagawat is one of the oldest Christian cemeteries in the world, with more than 260 painted funerary chapels.

IV

Civilisations across time

Pharaonic, Persian, Greek, Roman and Coptic cultures each left their mark here. More than 4,000 years of history in a single oasis.

Visit them onthe Cairo – Kharga route.

Days 8 to 10 of the expedition: Om el-Dabadib, Labakha, the Temple of Hibis and El-Bagawat.

How itwas built.

A tribute to the people who built Sand Gate Camp — by hand, in earth, from 2009, in the small oasis of Abu Monkar.

A moderncaravanserai.

Construction began in 2009 in Abu Monkar, a small oasis in Egypt’s Western Desert. The idea was a modern caravanserai: a resting place for travellers between Farafra and Dakhla, and a gateway to the Great Sand Sea.

The builders followed the earth-construction methods of the Egyptian architect Hassan Fathy, adapted to the local climate and terrain — thick walls, vaults and domes that keep the interior cool without machines.

Thick walls and shaded courtyards that hold the cool of the night.

بدأ البناء عام 2009، بأساليب البناء التقليدية في الواحات. يشغل المخيم أرضًا مساحتها ٥٠٠٠ م² تحيط بها نحو ٨٠ هكتارًا من بساتين النخيل والأشجار المثمرة.

يتبع تصميمه الخانات القديمة التي آوت المسافرين على طرق الصحراء: غرف حول أفنية مظللة، وجدران طينية سميكة تصدّ الحر، وتراسات مفتوحة على الأفق. مواد محلية في تصميم داخلي دافئ وبسيط.

إنه قاعدتنا لعبور الصحراء: المكان الذي تستريح فيه الرحلات وتتجمع من جديد قبل أن تنطلق نحو بحر الرمال الأعظم.

كبارالمستكشفين.

ثلاثة رجال فتحوا الطرق ورسموا أولى الخرائط الموثوقة وكشفوا أسرار الصحراء المصرية والليبية.

I1889 – 1946

أحمد حسنين باشا

مستكشف ودبلوماسي ومصور وكاتب مصري. وُلد في القاهرة وتعلّم في أكسفورد.

في عام 1923 عبر الصحراء الليبية من سيوة إلى الكفرة وما بعدها، ورسم خرائط لأجزاء من الصحراء الليبية لم تُرسم من قبل. ونشر نتائجه في The Geographical Journal و National Geographic.

وأصبح لاحقًا رئيسًا للديوان الملكي المصري ومستشارًا للملك فاروق.

II1874 – 1932

الأمير كمال الدين حسين

أحد أفراد الأسرة المالكة المصرية، شغوف بالآثار وجغرافيا الصحراء.

بين عامي ١٩٢٠ و١٩٢٤ موّل وقاد رحلات إلى الصحراء الكبرى أنتجت بعضًا من أولى الخرائط الدقيقة للصحراء الليبية.

وكان راعيًا للمستكشفين وللجمعية الجغرافية المصرية.

III1895 – 1951

لازلو ألماسي

مستكشف وطيار ومغامر مجري، ومصدر إلهام فيلم المريض الإنجليزي.

منذ الثلاثينيات استكشف الصحراء الشرقية بالسيارة والطائرة، واكتشف كهف السبّاحين في الجلف الكبير برسومه التي تعود إلى ما قبل التاريخ.

وخلال الحرب العالمية الثانية خدم دول المحور في شمال أفريقيا طيارًا وعميل استخبارات.

علم ومغامرةودبلوماسية.

فتح هؤلاء الرجال الثلاثة الطرق، وأعدّوا الخرائط، وكشفوا أسرار الصحراء المصرية والليبية. وبفضل إرثهم يستطيع المسافرون اليوم اقتفاء آثارهم.

كان يعبر الصحراء النوبية والصحراء الكبرى الشرقية. من الجنوب جاء الذهب والعاج والصمغ العربي، وكذلك أناس مستعبَدون. ومن الشمال الحبوب والكتان والملح.

صفوف طويلة تسير بخطى المشي، بضع عشرات من الكيلومترات يوميًا.

  • تأشيرة دخول مصر

الشروق والغروب بين الكثبان وسماء النجوم ليلًا. أحضر بطاريات احتياطية وحقيبة مقاومة للغبار.

عروض الأسعار عبر واتساب

أرسل لنا تواريخك وعدد المجموعة وسنرد بعرض سعر مخصص لك.

يُبنى من الصفر وفق تواريخ رحلاتكم وطبيعة عملائكم.

أسعار صافية وشروط تعاون وبرامج بالإنجليزية ومواد مصورة.

نكيّف المسارات والتواريخ مع كتالوجكم وموسمكم.

يسافر عملاؤكم مع فريقنا من مطار القاهرة حتى بحر الرمال الأعظم.

كيفبُني.

تحية لمن بنوا Sand Gate Camp بأيديهم، بالطين، منذ ٢٠٠٩، في واحة أبو منقار الصغيرة.

خانٌخانٍ صحراوي.

بدأ البناء عام 2009 في أبو منقار، الواحة الصغيرة في الصحراء الغربية بمصر. كانت الفكرة خانًا عصريًا: محطة استراحة للمسافرين بين الفرافرة والداخلة، وبوابة إلى بحر الرمال الأعظم.

اتبع البناؤون أساليب البناء بالطين للمعماري المصري حسن فتحي، مكيّفة مع المناخ والأرض المحليين: جدران سميكة وأقبية وقباب تحفظ برودة الداخل دون آلات.

طين ونخيلوصبر.

ما يجعل المخيم يلائم الصحراء.

مبني للحر

بناه أهل الواحة بمواد محلية.

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><style id="sgc-style">/* Sand Gate Camp — design system replicated from the Lunevar reference.
   Layout: full-bleed photographic chapters alternating dawn-sand light and night ink,
   with one sunset gradient carrying the reader from day into night. */
:root{
  --cream:#fbf6ee;
  --sand-50:#f5ede1;
  --sand-100:#f3e7d6;
  --sand-200:#efe4d3;
  --sand-300:#ebddc8;
  --dune:#e6bc91;
  --apricot:#f0b784;
  --peach:#efc9a2;
  --amber:#e2a877;
  --copper:#c8642c;
  --copper-deep:#b2531f;
  --clay:#b8663f;
  --rust:#7a4234;
  --rose:#7a4a45;
  --wine:#4a2a2a;
  --plum:#2b1c24;
  --ink:#2a1d14;
  --ink-2:#3b2a1e;
  --night:#110d0c;
  --night-2:#1c1314;
  --muted:#6f5d4f;
  --muted-dark:rgba(251,246,238,.66);
  --line:rgba(42,29,20,.14);
  --line-dark:rgba(251,246,238,.14);

  --f-display:"Fraunces","Fraunces Placeholder",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  --f-body:"Hanken Grotesk","Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;

  --ease-out:cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1);
  --ease-in-out:cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.175,1);
  --ease-drawer:cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1);

  --gutter:max(20px, env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));
  --gutter-r:max(20px, env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));
  --wrap:1360px;
  --radius:22px;
  --radius-lg:28px;
}
@media (min-width:810px){:root{--gutter:max(40px, env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));--gutter-r:max(40px, env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}}

*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;scroll-behavior:auto}
body{margin:0;background:var(--sand-50);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:16px;line-height:1.55;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;overflow-x:hidden}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:0}
::selection{background:var(--copper);color:var(--cream)}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--copper);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}
.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}

/* ---------- Type ---------- */
.display,.h1,.h2,.h3{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-variation-settings:"opsz" 72,"SOFT" 0,"WONK" 1;margin:0;text-wrap:balance;font-optical-sizing:auto}
.display{font-size:clamp(3.4rem,9.2vw,9rem);line-height:.94;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.h1{font-size:clamp(2.9rem,6.6vw,6.4rem);line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.h2{font-size:clamp(2.5rem,5.2vw,5rem);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.028em}
.h3{font-size:clamp(1.6rem,2.4vw,2.2rem);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.display em,.h1 em,.h2 em,.h3 em,.statement em,.quote em{font-style:italic;color:var(--copper)}
.on-dark .display em,.on-dark .h1 em,.on-dark .h2 em,.on-dark .h3 em,.on-dark .quote em,.hero em,.chapter em,.plan .head em,.sunset em{color:var(--apricot)}
.lede{font-size:clamp(1rem,1.2vw,1.125rem);line-height:1.6;color:var(--muted);max-width:44ch;margin:0;text-wrap:pretty}
.on-dark .lede{color:var(--muted-dark)}
.eyebrow{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
.on-dark .eyebrow{color:var(--muted-dark)}
.mono{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:.06em}
.prose{max-width:66ch}
.prose p{margin:0 0 1.1em;color:var(--muted);font-size:1.0625rem;line-height:1.7;text-wrap:pretty}
.prose p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.prose strong{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.on-dark .prose p{color:var(--muted-dark)}
.on-dark .prose strong{color:var(--cream)}

/* ---------- Layout ---------- */
.wrap{max-width:var(--wrap);margin:0 auto;padding-left:var(--gutter);padding-right:var(--gutter-r)}
.section{padding-block:clamp(96px,12vw,180px)}
.section.tight{padding-block:clamp(72px,8vw,120px)}
.on-dark{background:var(--night);color:var(--cream)}
.bg-sand{background:var(--sand-200)}
.bg-cream{background:var(--sand-50)}
.split-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:28px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:clamp(48px,6vw,88px)}
@media (min-width:960px){.split-head{grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr;gap:64px}.split-head .lede{justify-self:end}}
.split-head .side{display:grid;gap:24px;justify-items:start}
@media (min-width:960px){.split-head .side{justify-self:end;max-width:400px}}

/* ---------- Buttons & pills ---------- */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;height:52px;padding:0 26px;border-radius:999px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;transition:transform 160ms var(--ease-out),background-color 200ms ease,color 200ms ease,border-color 200ms ease}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.btn svg{width:16px;height:16px;transition:transform 200ms var(--ease-out)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.btn:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px)}}
.btn-light{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.btn-light:hover{background:var(--peach)}}
.btn-copper{background:var(--copper);color:var(--cream)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.btn-copper:hover{background:var(--copper-deep)}}
.btn-dark{background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.btn-dark:hover{background:var(--ink-2)}}
.btn-ghost{border:1px solid currentColor;border-color:rgba(251,246,238,.32);color:var(--cream)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--cream);background:rgba(251,246,238,.06)}}
.btn-ghost-ink{border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.btn-ghost-ink:hover{border-color:var(--ink)}}
.btn-sm{height:42px;padding:0 18px;font-size:14px}
.link-arrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:15px;padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;transition:gap 200ms var(--ease-out)}
.link-arrow svg{width:15px;height:15px}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.link-arrow:hover{gap:14px}}
.pills{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:28px;padding:0 11px;border-radius:999px;font-size:13px;background:rgba(42,29,20,.06);border:1px solid rgba(42,29,20,.1);color:var(--ink-2);white-space:nowrap}
.pill svg{width:13px;height:13px;opacity:.75}
.on-dark .pill,.pill.dark{background:rgba(251,246,238,.06);border-color:rgba(251,246,238,.14);color:rgba(251,246,238,.86)}
.pill.copper{background:rgba(200,100,44,.12);border-color:rgba(200,100,44,.3);color:var(--apricot)}

/* ---------- Media placeholder (images hotlinked; gradient shows if they fail) ---------- */
.media{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--dune),var(--clay) 55%,var(--rust))}
.media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 900ms var(--ease-out),opacity 400ms ease}
.media img.failed{opacity:0}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.zoom:hover .media img{transform:scale(1.04)}}

/* ---------- Loader ---------- */
.loader{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;background:var(--cream);display:none;pointer-events:none}
html.js.show-loader .loader{display:block;pointer-events:auto}
.loader .mark{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:50%;transform:translateY(calc(-50% - 16px));display:flex;justify-content:center}
.loader .word{position:relative;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,40px);letter-spacing:.34em;padding-left:.34em;line-height:1.22;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--ink)}
.loader .word .ghost{opacity:.13}
.loader .word .fill{position:absolute;inset:0;padding-left:.34em;clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0)}
.loader .word .bar{position:absolute;top:20%;height:61%;width:1px;background:var(--copper);left:0}
.loader .tag{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:clamp(48px,8vh,78px);text-align:center;font-family:var(--f-display);font-style:italic;font-weight:300;font-size:15px;color:var(--ink)}
.loader .tag span{opacity:.42}
.loader .pct{position:absolute;right:clamp(28px,4vw,56px);bottom:clamp(44px,8vh,74px);font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,28px);color:var(--ink);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.loader .pct small{font-size:.6em;opacity:.6}

/* Page transition veil */
.veil{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:190;background:var(--cream);transform:translateY(100%);pointer-events:none;will-change:transform;visibility:hidden}
.veil .vw{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);text-align:center;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(22px,3vw,32px);letter-spacing:.34em;padding-left:.34em;color:var(--ink);opacity:.2}
html.veil-in .veil{transform:none;visibility:visible}

/* ---------- Header ---------- */
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:101;background:var(--night)}
.header{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:100;color:var(--cream);transition:color 300ms ease}
.header::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(245,237,225,.76);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(160%);backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(160%);opacity:0;transition:opacity 300ms ease;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(42,29,20,.08)}
.header.scrolled{color:var(--ink)}
.header.scrolled::before{opacity:1}
.header-in{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;align-items:center;height:76px;max-width:none;padding-left:var(--gutter);padding-right:var(--gutter-r)}
@media (min-width:1180px){.header-in{grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr}}
.brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:400;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:.14em;white-space:nowrap}
.brand small{font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.28em;opacity:.7;font-weight:500}
.nav{display:none}
@media (min-width:1180px){.nav{display:flex;gap:4px;justify-self:center}}
.nav-item{position:relative}
.nav-link{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;height:44px;padding:0 13px;font-size:14px;opacity:.92;transition:opacity 200ms ease,color 200ms ease}
.nav-link svg{width:10px;height:10px;opacity:.6;transition:transform 200ms var(--ease-out)}
.nav-link[aria-current="page"],.nav-item.current>.nav-link{color:var(--copper);opacity:1}
.header:not(.scrolled) .nav-link[aria-current="page"],.header:not(.scrolled) .nav-item.current>.nav-link{color:var(--apricot)}
.nav-link[aria-current="page"]::after,.nav-item.current>.nav-link::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:4px;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;transform:translateX(-50%)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.nav-link:hover{opacity:1}}
.dropdown{position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 6px);left:50%;min-width:250px;padding:8px;border-radius:18px;background:rgba(251,246,238,.94);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(170%);backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(170%);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 24px 60px -20px rgba(42,29,20,.35),0 0 0 1px rgba(42,29,20,.06);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transform:translateX(-50%) scale(.96);transform-origin:top center;transition:opacity 180ms var(--ease-out),transform 180ms var(--ease-out),visibility 0s linear 180ms}
.dropdown::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:-12px;height:12px}
.nav-item:focus-within .dropdown,.nav-item.open .dropdown{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:translateX(-50%) scale(1);transition:opacity 180ms var(--ease-out),transform 180ms var(--ease-out),visibility 0s}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.nav-item:hover .dropdown{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:translateX(-50%) scale(1);transition:opacity 180ms var(--ease-out),transform 180ms var(--ease-out),visibility 0s}.nav-item:hover .nav-link svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}}
.dropdown a{display:grid;gap:1px;padding:11px 14px;border-radius:12px;transition:background-color 160ms ease}
.dropdown a b{font-weight:500;font-size:14px}
.dropdown a span{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.dropdown a[aria-current="page"] b{color:var(--copper)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.dropdown a:hover{background:rgba(42,29,20,.06)}}
.header-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;justify-self:end}
.clock{display:none;align-items:center;gap:10px;height:36px;padding:0 14px 0 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(17,13,12,.32);border:1px solid rgba(251,246,238,.12);font-size:12.5px;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);transition:background-color 300ms ease,border-color 300ms ease}
.header.scrolled .clock{background:rgba(42,29,20,.06);border-color:rgba(42,29,20,.1)}
@media (min-width:700px){.clock{display:inline-flex}}
.clock svg{width:26px;height:14px;overflow:visible}
.clock .t{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:15px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.clock .sep{width:1px;height:12px;background:currentColor;opacity:.25}
.clock .ph{opacity:.7;letter-spacing:.02em}
.header .cta{height:44px;padding:0 20px;font-size:14px}
.header.scrolled .cta{background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream)}
.header .cta .short{display:none}
@media (max-width:520px){.header .cta .long{display:none}.header .cta .short{display:inline}}
.burger{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(251,246,238,.24);transition:border-color 300ms ease,transform 160ms var(--ease-out)}
.burger:active{transform:scale(.95)}
.header.scrolled .burger{border-color:var(--line)}
.burger span{display:block;width:16px;height:1.5px;background:currentColor;box-shadow:0 5px 0 currentColor;transform:translateY(-2.5px)}
@media (min-width:1180px){.burger{display:none}}

/* Mobile sheet */
.sheet{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:150;background:var(--night);color:var(--cream);transform:translateY(-100%);transition:transform 500ms var(--ease-drawer);display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 18px) var(--gutter-r) calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 28px) var(--gutter);overflow-y:auto;visibility:hidden}
.sheet.open{transform:none;visibility:visible}
.sheet-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;height:44px}
.sheet-close{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line-dark);display:grid;place-items:center}
.sheet-close svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.sheet nav{display:grid;gap:2px;margin-top:40px}
.sheet nav a.big{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(34px,9vw,46px);line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.02em;opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);transition:opacity 400ms var(--ease-out),transform 400ms var(--ease-out)}
.sheet nav a.big[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--apricot);font-style:italic}
.sheet nav .sub{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 16px;padding:2px 0 12px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted-dark);opacity:0;transition:opacity 400ms var(--ease-out)}
.sheet.open nav a.big,.sheet.open nav .sub{opacity:1;transform:none}
.sheet-foot{margin-top:auto;padding-top:40px;display:grid;gap:14px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted-dark)}
.sheet-foot .btn{justify-self:start}

/* ---------- Hero ---------- */
.hero{position:relative;min-height:max(680px,min(100svh,980px));display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;color:var(--cream);background:var(--night);overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
.hero.short{min-height:max(560px,min(82svh,820px))}
.hero .bg{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2}
.hero .bg img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transform:scale(1.08);transition:transform 2400ms var(--ease-out),opacity 600ms ease}
html.ready .hero .bg img{transform:scale(1)}
.hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(17,13,12,.62) 0%,rgba(17,13,12,.25) 45%,rgba(17,13,12,0) 70%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(17,13,12,.6) 0%,rgba(17,13,12,.12) 28%,rgba(17,13,12,.3) 55%,rgba(17,13,12,.9) 100%)}
.hero-in{padding-top:140px;padding-bottom:clamp(28px,4vw,48px);display:grid;gap:clamp(32px,5vw,56px)}
.hero-copy{display:grid;gap:26px;max-width:1100px}
.hero .eyebrow{color:rgba(251,246,238,.78)}
.hero .hero-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;height:32px;padding:0 14px 0 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(17,13,12,.3);border:1px solid rgba(251,246,238,.16);font-size:13px;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);justify-self:start}
.hero .hero-tag i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--apricot);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(240,183,132,.2)}
.hero .lede{color:rgba(251,246,238,.82);max-width:52ch;font-size:clamp(1.02rem,1.3vw,1.2rem)}
.hero .ctas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.hero-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 28px;font-size:13px;color:rgba(251,246,238,.7)}
.hero-meta b{color:var(--cream);font-weight:500}

/* Split-line reveal for headings */
.lines .ln{display:block;overflow:hidden;padding-bottom:.08em;margin-bottom:-.08em}
.lines .ln>span{display:inline-block}
html.js .lines .ln>span{transform:translateY(105%);filter:blur(6px);opacity:0;transition:transform 1100ms var(--ease-out),filter 900ms var(--ease-out),opacity 700ms ease}
html.js .lines.in .ln>span{transform:none;filter:none;opacity:1}
html.js .lines .ln:nth-child(2)>span{transition-delay:90ms}
html.js .lines .ln:nth-child(3)>span{transition-delay:180ms}

/* Quick enquiry bar */
.quick{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;border-radius:var(--radius);background:rgba(28,19,20,.5);border:1px solid rgba(251,246,238,.14);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(150%);backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(150%);overflow:hidden}
@media (min-width:1100px){.quick{grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;align-items:stretch}}
.quick .sun{display:flex;gap:28px;padding:18px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark)}
@media (min-width:1100px){.quick .sun{border-bottom:0;border-right:1px solid var(--line-dark)}}
.quick .sun div{display:grid;gap:2px}
.quick .k{font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(251,246,238,.56)}
.quick .v{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:22px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.1}
.quick .fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
@media (min-width:760px){.quick .fields{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.quick label{position:relative;display:grid;gap:3px;padding:16px 22px;border-right:1px solid var(--line-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 200ms ease;min-width:0}
@media (min-width:760px){.quick label{border-bottom:0}.quick label:last-child{border-right:0}}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.quick label:hover{background:rgba(251,246,238,.05)}}
.quick select{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;background:transparent;border:0;color:var(--cream);font:inherit;font-size:15px;padding:0 18px 0 0;cursor:pointer;width:100%;outline:none;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.quick select option{color:var(--ink)}
.quick label::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:20px;bottom:22px;width:6px;height:6px;border-right:1.5px solid rgba(251,246,238,.6);border-bottom:1.5px solid rgba(251,246,238,.6);transform:rotate(45deg)}
.quick .go{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:12px}
.quick .go .btn{width:100%;justify-content:center}

/* ---------- Statement ---------- */
.statement{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-variation-settings:"opsz" 60;font-size:clamp(1.9rem,4.4vw,4.3rem);line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.022em;text-align:center;margin:0 auto;max-width:17em;text-wrap:balance}
.statement .w{transition:opacity 300ms ease}
html.js .statement .w{opacity:.16}
html.js .statement .w.on{opacity:1}
.statement .chip{display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;width:1.9em;height:.92em;border-radius:999px;margin:0 .12em;transform:translateY(-.06em);overflow:hidden}
.statement .chip img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:40px 24px;margin-top:clamp(72px,9vw,120px);padding-top:28px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
@media (min-width:900px){.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.stat b{display:block;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(2.6rem,4.4vw,4rem);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.stat span{display:block;margin-top:14px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);max-width:24ch}
.on-dark .stat span{color:var(--muted-dark)}

/* ---------- Day timeline with sun arc ---------- */
.day{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:48px}
@media (min-width:1000px){.day{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:64px}}
.day-left{display:grid;gap:56px;align-content:start}
@media (min-width:1000px){.day-left{position:sticky;top:120px;align-self:start}}
.arc{width:100%;max-width:620px;overflow:visible}
.arc text{font-family:var(--f-body);font-size:11px;fill:var(--ink);letter-spacing:.06em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.arc .lbl{opacity:.75}
.arc .dot{fill:var(--copper)}
.arc .sunglow{fill:url(#sunGlow)}
.arc #arcSun{transition:transform 900ms var(--ease-in-out)}
.cards{display:grid;gap:22px}
.tcard{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px;padding:14px;border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--cream);box-shadow:0 30px 60px -40px rgba(42,29,20,.35),0 0 0 1px rgba(42,29,20,.04);transition:transform 400ms var(--ease-out),box-shadow 400ms var(--ease-out)}
@media (min-width:600px){.tcard{grid-template-columns:200px 1fr;gap:26px}}
.tcard .media{border-radius:14px;aspect-ratio:4/3}
@media (min-width:600px){.tcard .media{aspect-ratio:auto;min-height:170px}}
.tcard .body{display:grid;gap:10px;align-content:center;padding:6px 8px 8px 0}
.tcard .time{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.tcard h3{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,2.2vw,2.1rem);line-height:1.05;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.tcard p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
.tcard.active{box-shadow:0 40px 80px -40px rgba(200,100,44,.45),0 0 0 1px rgba(200,100,44,.22)}

/* ---------- Expedition cards ---------- */
.trips{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px 28px}
@media (min-width:900px){.trips{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.trips>.trip:nth-child(2){margin-top:72px}}
.trip{display:grid;gap:20px}
.trip .media{border-radius:var(--radius);aspect-ratio:4/5}
.trip .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:16px;padding-bottom:18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.trip h3{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(1.7rem,2.4vw,2.3rem);line-height:1.02;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.018em}
.trip .price{text-align:right;font-size:14px;white-space:nowrap}
.trip .price small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em}
.trip p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
.trip .tag-top{position:absolute;left:16px;top:16px;z-index:1}

/* ---------- Marquee ---------- */
.marquee{background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream);overflow:hidden;padding-block:26px;border-block:1px solid rgba(251,246,238,.06)}
.marquee .track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:marq 48s linear infinite}
.marquee .grp{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:48px;padding-right:48px;font-family:var(--f-display);font-style:italic;font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,2.2vw,2rem);white-space:nowrap}
.marquee svg{width:22px;height:22px;color:var(--copper);flex:none}
@keyframes marq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.marquee:hover .track{animation-play-state:paused}}

/* ---------- Dark image chapter ---------- */
.chapter{position:relative;color:var(--cream);background:var(--night-2);overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
.chapter .bg{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2}
.chapter .bg img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.chapter::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(28,19,20,.92) 0%,rgba(28,19,20,.45) 40%,rgba(28,19,20,.55) 70%,rgba(28,19,20,.92) 100%)}
.chapter .head{text-align:center;display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:22px}
.chapter .head .lede{text-align:center;margin:0 auto}
.glass-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:clamp(120px,18vw,260px);max-width:1080px;margin-inline:auto}
@media (min-width:900px){.glass-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.glass{display:grid;gap:30px;align-content:space-between;min-height:128px;padding:18px 20px;border-radius:18px;background:rgba(251,246,238,.08);border:1px solid rgba(251,246,238,.16);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(140%);backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(140%)}
.glass b{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(1.7rem,2.4vw,2.2rem);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.glass span{font-size:13.5px;color:rgba(251,246,238,.78);line-height:1.4}
.glass:last-child:nth-child(odd){grid-column:1/-1}
@media (min-width:900px){.glass:last-child:nth-child(odd){grid-column:auto}}

/* ---------- Accordion programs ---------- */
.prog{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:48px}
@media (min-width:1000px){.prog{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.9fr) minmax(0,1.25fr);gap:56px}.prog .left{position:sticky;top:120px;align-self:start}}
.prog .left{display:grid;gap:28px;align-content:start}
.acc{display:grid;gap:14px}
.acc-item{border-radius:var(--radius-lg);background:var(--sand-50);color:var(--ink);transition:background-color 400ms ease,color 400ms ease;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(42,29,20,.05)}
.acc-item.open{background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream)}
.acc-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:20px;width:100%;padding:24px 24px 0;text-align:left}
@media (min-width:700px){.acc-head{padding:28px 30px 0}}
.acc-head .num{font-family:var(--f-display);font-style:italic;font-size:20px;color:var(--copper);min-width:28px}
.acc-item.open .acc-head .num{color:var(--apricot)}
.acc-head h3{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(2rem,3.6vw,3.2rem);line-height:1;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.acc-head .right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.acc-head .right .pills{display:none}
@media (min-width:760px){.acc-head .right .pills{display:flex}}
.acc-item.open .pill{background:rgba(251,246,238,.06);border-color:rgba(251,246,238,.14);color:rgba(251,246,238,.86)}
.acc-toggle{width:44px;height:44px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;transition:background-color 300ms ease,border-color 300ms ease,transform 160ms var(--ease-out)}
.acc-head:active .acc-toggle{transform:scale(.94)}
.acc-toggle i{position:relative;width:13px;height:1.5px;background:currentColor}
.acc-toggle i::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:currentColor;transform:rotate(90deg);transition:transform 300ms var(--ease-out)}
.acc-item.open .acc-toggle{background:var(--apricot);border-color:var(--apricot);color:var(--ink)}
.acc-item.open .acc-toggle i::after{transform:rotate(0)}
.acc-sum{padding:16px 24px 26px 72px;margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:15.5px;max-width:62ch}
@media (min-width:700px){.acc-sum{padding:18px 30px 28px 78px}}
.acc-item.open .acc-sum{color:rgba(251,246,238,.78)}
.acc-body{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows 320ms var(--ease-out)}
.acc-item.open .acc-body{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.acc-body>div{overflow:hidden;min-height:0}
.acc-inner{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px;padding:0 24px 28px;opacity:0;transition:opacity 260ms ease}
.acc-item.open .acc-inner{opacity:1;transition-delay:80ms}
@media (min-width:760px){.acc-inner{grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;padding:0 30px 30px}}
.acc-inner .media{border-radius:16px;min-height:240px}
.acc-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid}
.acc-list li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:34px 1fr;gap:6px;padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark);font-size:15px}
.acc-list li span{font-size:11px;color:var(--apricot);letter-spacing:.06em;padding-top:3px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.acc-ctas{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;padding-top:6px}

/* ---------- Experience grid ---------- */
.exp{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px 22px}
@media (min-width:640px){.exp{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media (min-width:1100px){.exp{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.exp-item{display:grid;gap:16px}
.exp-item .media{border-radius:18px;aspect-ratio:3/4}
.exp-item h3{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(1.35rem,1.8vw,1.7rem);margin:0;letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.1}
.exp-item h3 i{font-size:.62em;color:var(--copper-deep)}
.exp-item p{margin:0;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.grad-land{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--sand-200) 0%,var(--sand-300) 45%,var(--dune) 100%)}

/* ---------- Sunset chapter ---------- */
.sunset{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--dune) 0%,var(--clay) 20%,var(--rust) 42%,var(--wine) 62%,var(--plum) 80%,var(--night) 100%);color:var(--cream)}
.sunset-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
@media (min-width:1000px){.sunset-grid{grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:72px}}
.sunset .media{border-radius:var(--radius-lg);aspect-ratio:4/5;box-shadow:0 60px 120px -60px rgba(17,13,12,.7)}
.sunset-copy{display:grid;gap:26px;align-content:center}
.sunset .h2 em{color:var(--apricot)}
.sunset .lede{color:rgba(251,246,238,.8)}
.menu{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;border-top:1px solid rgba(251,246,238,.18)}
.menu li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr;gap:10px;padding:15px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(251,246,238,.18);font-size:15.5px}
.menu li i{font-family:var(--f-display);color:var(--apricot)}
.menu li span{color:rgba(251,246,238,.68);font-size:14px;display:block}

/* ---------- Night cards ---------- */
.night-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px;margin-top:clamp(56px,7vw,96px)}
@media (min-width:900px){.night-cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.ncard{border-radius:var(--radius);background:rgba(251,246,238,.04);border:1px solid rgba(251,246,238,.08);padding:12px;display:grid;gap:18px;align-content:start}
.ncard .media{border-radius:14px;aspect-ratio:16/11}
.ncard .b{display:grid;gap:10px;padding:2px 12px 14px}
.ncard h3{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,2.2vw,2rem);margin:0;letter-spacing:-.015em;line-height:1.05}
.ncard p{margin:0;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted-dark)}

/* ---------- Reasons carousel ---------- */
.quotes{position:relative;text-align:center;display:grid;justify-items:center}
.quote-stage{display:grid;width:100%}
.quote{grid-area:1/1;display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:30px;opacity:0;filter:blur(8px);transform:translateY(10px);transition:opacity 600ms ease,filter 600ms ease,transform 700ms var(--ease-out);pointer-events:none}
.quote.on{opacity:1;filter:none;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}
.quote p{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.8vw,3.4rem);line-height:1.14;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0;max-width:22em;text-wrap:balance}
.quote .meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:center;align-items:center;font-size:14px}
.dots{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:56px}
.dots button{position:relative;width:26px;height:24px}
.dots button::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:50%;height:2px;margin-top:-1px;border-radius:2px;background:rgba(251,246,238,.22);transition:background-color 300ms ease}
.dots button[aria-current="true"]::before{background:var(--cream)}

/* ---------- Trade band ---------- */
.trade{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px;padding:clamp(28px,4vw,56px);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);background:var(--cream);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(42,29,20,.06)}
@media (min-width:1000px){.trade{grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:64px;align-items:center}}
.trade .h2{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,4.2vw,4rem)}
.ticks{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid}
.ticks li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:28px 1fr;gap:6px;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:15.5px}
.ticks li:first-child{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.ticks svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--copper);margin-top:4px}
.on-dark .ticks li{border-color:var(--line-dark)}

/* ---------- Plan / calendar ---------- */
.plan{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--night) 0%,var(--plum) 30%,var(--rose) 62%,var(--dune) 88%,var(--sand-50) 100%);color:var(--cream);padding-block:clamp(110px,13vw,190px) clamp(90px,10vw,150px)}
.plan .head{text-align:center;display:grid;gap:20px;justify-items:center;margin-bottom:clamp(48px,6vw,80px)}
.plan .head .lede{text-align:center;margin:0 auto}
.planner{max-width:960px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);background:var(--sand-50);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 60px 120px -50px rgba(17,13,12,.55);overflow:hidden}
@media (min-width:860px){.planner{grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr}}
.cal{padding:clamp(22px,3vw,40px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
@media (min-width:860px){.cal{border-bottom:0;border-right:1px solid var(--line)}}
.cal-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:22px}
.cal-top h3{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:26px;margin:0}
.cal-nav{display:flex;gap:8px}
.cal-nav button{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;transition:transform 160ms var(--ease-out),border-color 200ms ease}
.cal-nav button:active{transform:scale(.94)}
.cal-nav button:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default}
.cal-nav svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.cal-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));row-gap:4px;text-align:center;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.cal-grid .dow{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--muted);padding-bottom:10px}
.cal-grid button{position:relative;height:40px;font-size:14px;border-radius:0;transition:background-color 160ms ease,color 160ms ease}
.cal-grid button span{position:relative;z-index:1;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;transition:background-color 160ms ease,transform 160ms var(--ease-out)}
.cal-grid button:active span{transform:scale(.92)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.cal-grid button:not(:disabled):hover span{background:rgba(42,29,20,.07)}}
.cal-grid button:disabled{color:rgba(42,29,20,.25);cursor:default}
.cal-grid button.in{background:var(--sand-300)}
.cal-grid button.start{background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 50%,var(--sand-300) 50%)}
.cal-grid button.end{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--sand-300) 50%,transparent 50%)}
.cal-grid button.start.end{background:none}
.cal-grid button.start span,.cal-grid button.end span{background:var(--copper)!important;color:var(--cream);font-weight:600}
.cal-grid button.moon::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:1px;width:4px;height:4px;margin-left:-2px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink)}
.cal-note{margin:18px 0 0;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.stay{padding:clamp(22px,3vw,40px);display:grid;gap:4px;align-content:start}
.stay .eyebrow{font-size:11px;margin-bottom:10px}
.stay-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:14.5px}
.stay-row>span:first-child{color:var(--muted)}
.stay-row b{font-weight:500;text-align:right}
.stay-row select{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;border:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;font-weight:500;text-align:right;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;padding-right:16px;background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 50%,var(--ink) 50%),linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ink) 50%,transparent 50%);background-position:calc(100% - 5px) 50%,100% 50%;background-size:5px 5px;background-repeat:no-repeat;max-width:62%}
.stay .total{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;padding:18px 0 22px}
.stay .total b{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:30px}
.stay .btn{justify-content:center}
.stay .fine{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center}

/* ---------- Footer ---------- */
.footer{background:var(--sand-200);color:var(--ink);position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding-top:clamp(80px,9vw,130px)}
.foot-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:48px}
@media (min-width:960px){.foot-top{grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:40px}}
.foot-top .h2{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,3.8vw,3.6rem)}
.foot-col{display:grid;gap:12px;align-content:start;font-size:15.5px}
.foot-col h4{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
.foot-col a{transition:color 200ms ease}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.foot-col a:hover{color:var(--copper)}}
.contact-lines{display:grid;gap:10px;margin-top:22px}
.contact-lines a,.contact-lines div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:15px}
.contact-lines svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--copper);flex:none}
.foot-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:72px;padding-block:26px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.foot-bar .pill{color:var(--ink)}
.giant{position:relative;text-align:center;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:400;font-variation-settings:"opsz" 36,"SOFT" 0;font-size:clamp(3rem,15.5vw,17rem);line-height:.82;letter-spacing:-.02em;white-space:nowrap;padding-top:clamp(20px,4vw,60px);margin-bottom:-.12em;user-select:none}
.giant::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:60%;width:min(620px,70vw);aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(226,120,60,.7) 0%,rgba(232,150,100,.35) 35%,rgba(239,201,162,0) 70%);z-index:0;pointer-events:none}
.giant span{position:relative;z-index:1}

/* ---------- Floating WhatsApp ---------- */
.wa{position:fixed;right:calc(env(safe-area-inset-right,0px) + 18px);bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 18px);z-index:90;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;height:52px;padding:0 18px 0 14px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream);font-size:14px;box-shadow:0 20px 40px -18px rgba(17,13,12,.6);transition:transform 160ms var(--ease-out),opacity 300ms ease;opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px);pointer-events:none}
.wa.show{opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}
.wa:active{transform:scale(.96)}
.wa svg{width:20px;height:20px;color:#7fd18f}
@media (max-width:520px){.wa span{display:none}.wa{width:52px;padding:0;justify-content:center}}

/* ---------- Inner pages ---------- */
.crumbs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;font-size:13px;color:rgba(251,246,238,.7)}
.crumbs a{color:rgba(251,246,238,.9)}
.crumbs span{opacity:.5}
.factbar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));border-radius:var(--radius);background:rgba(28,19,20,.5);border:1px solid var(--line-dark);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(22px);backdrop-filter:blur(22px);overflow:hidden}
@media (min-width:900px){.factbar{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.factbar>div{padding:16px 22px;border-right:1px solid var(--line-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-dark);display:grid;gap:3px;min-width:0}
@media (min-width:900px){.factbar>div{border-bottom:0}.factbar>div:last-child{border-right:0}}
.factbar .k{font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(251,246,238,.56)}
.factbar .v{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:19px;line-height:1.2}
.intro-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px}
@media (min-width:1000px){.intro-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:80px;align-items:start}}
.features{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px}
@media (min-width:700px){.features{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media (min-width:1100px){.features.three{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.feature{padding:26px;border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--cream);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(42,29,20,.06);display:grid;gap:12px;align-content:start}
.feature .ic{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(200,100,44,.1);color:var(--copper)}
.feature .ic svg{width:19px;height:19px}
.feature h3{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:1.55rem;line-height:1.1;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.feature p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
.on-dark .feature{background:rgba(251,246,238,.04);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(251,246,238,.08)}
.on-dark .feature p{color:var(--muted-dark)}
.gallery{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
@media (min-width:900px){.gallery{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));grid-auto-rows:240px}.gallery .tall{grid-row:span 2}.gallery .wide{grid-column:span 2}}
.gallery .media{border-radius:16px;aspect-ratio:1}
@media (min-width:900px){.gallery .media{aspect-ratio:auto}}
.gallery figure{margin:0;display:contents}

/* Editorial alternating rows */
.rows{display:grid;gap:clamp(72px,9vw,140px)}
.erow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px;align-items:center}
@media (min-width:1000px){.erow{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:80px}.erow.flip .media{order:2}}
.erow .media{border-radius:var(--radius-lg);aspect-ratio:5/4}
.erow .copy{display:grid;gap:22px;align-content:center}
.erow .idx{font-family:var(--f-display);font-style:italic;color:var(--copper);font-size:20px}
.erow .years{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}

/* Itinerary */
.itin{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:48px}
@media (min-width:1000px){.itin{grid-template-columns:280px 1fr;gap:64px}}
.itin-nav{display:none}
@media (min-width:1000px){.itin-nav{display:grid;gap:2px;position:sticky;top:110px;align-self:start}}
.itin-nav a{display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px 1fr;gap:6px;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:12px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);transition:background-color 200ms ease,color 200ms ease}
.itin-nav a b{font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.itin-nav a.on{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(42,29,20,.06)}
.itin-nav a.on b{color:var(--copper)}
.days{display:grid;gap:18px}
.dcard{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:22px;padding:14px;border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--cream);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(42,29,20,.05);scroll-margin-top:110px}
@media (min-width:700px){.dcard{grid-template-columns:240px 1fr;gap:28px}}
.dcard .media{border-radius:14px;aspect-ratio:4/3}
@media (min-width:700px){.dcard .media{aspect-ratio:auto;min-height:190px}}
.dcard .b{display:grid;gap:10px;align-content:center;padding:4px 10px 10px 4px}
.dcard .dn{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--copper);font-weight:600}
.dcard h3{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(1.5rem,2vw,1.9rem);line-height:1.08;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.012em}
.dcard p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
.incl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px}
@media (min-width:860px){.incl{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.incl .box{padding:clamp(24px,3vw,36px);border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--cream);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(42,29,20,.06)}
.incl .box h3{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:1.8rem;margin:0 0 14px}
.incl .box.no svg{color:var(--muted)}
.note{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:18px}

/* Forms */
.form{display:grid;gap:14px}
.form .grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px}
@media (min-width:700px){.form .grid2{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.field{display:grid;gap:7px}
.field label{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.02em}
.field input,.field select,.field textarea{width:100%;font:inherit;font-size:15.5px;color:var(--ink);background:var(--cream);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;transition:border-color 200ms ease,box-shadow 200ms ease;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none}
.field textarea{min-height:140px;resize:vertical}
.field input:focus,.field select:focus,.field textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--copper);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(200,100,44,.12)}
.field select{background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 50%,var(--ink) 50%),linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ink) 50%,transparent 50%);background-position:calc(100% - 22px) 52%,calc(100% - 17px) 52%;background-size:5px 5px;background-repeat:no-repeat;padding-right:40px}
.checks{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.checks label{position:relative;cursor:pointer}
.checks input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.checks span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:38px;padding:0 15px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:14px;background:var(--cream);transition:background-color 160ms ease,color 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease,transform 160ms var(--ease-out)}
.checks label:active span{transform:scale(.97)}
.checks input:checked+span{background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream);border-color:var(--ink)}
.checks input:focus-visible+span{outline:2px solid var(--copper);outline-offset:2px}
.form-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin-top:6px}
.form-msg{font-size:14px;color:var(--copper-deep);min-height:1.4em;margin:0}
.panel{padding:clamp(24px,3.4vw,44px);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);background:var(--sand-50);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(42,29,20,.06)}
.contact-cards{display:grid;gap:12px}
.ccard{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr;gap:16px;align-items:center;padding:18px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--cream);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(42,29,20,.06)}
.ccard .ic{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(200,100,44,.1);color:var(--copper)}
.ccard .ic svg{width:19px;height:19px}
.ccard small{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.ccard b{font-weight:500;font-size:16px;word-break:break-word}
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px;counter-reset:s}
@media (min-width:900px){.steps{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.step{padding:26px;border-radius:var(--radius);border:1px solid var(--line-dark);display:grid;gap:14px;align-content:start}
.step i{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:34px;color:var(--apricot);font-style:italic;line-height:1}
.step h3{margin:0;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1.1}
.step p{margin:0;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted-dark)}
.video{position:relative;display:block;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:var(--night-2)}
.video img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;opacity:.75;transition:transform 900ms var(--ease-out),opacity 300ms ease}
.video .play{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center}
.video .play span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;height:60px;padding:0 26px 0 20px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-size:15px;font-weight:500;transition:transform 160ms var(--ease-out)}
.video:active .play span{transform:scale(.97)}
.video .play svg{width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--copper)}
.video iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.video:hover img{transform:scale(1.03);opacity:.85}}
.map{border-radius:var(--radius-lg);overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:16/10;background:var(--sand-300)}
.map iframe{width:100%;height:100%;border:0;filter:sepia(.35) saturate(.85)}
.linkcards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px}
@media (min-width:900px){.linkcards{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.lcard{display:grid;gap:18px}
.lcard .media{border-radius:var(--radius);aspect-ratio:4/3}
.lcard h3{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,2.2vw,2.1rem);margin:0;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.lcard p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
.on-dark .lcard p{color:var(--muted-dark)}
.timeline-band{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1px;background:var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line)}
@media (min-width:900px){.timeline-band{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.timeline-band div{background:var(--cream);padding:22px;display:grid;gap:8px}
.timeline-band div:last-child:nth-child(odd){grid-column:1/-1}
@media (min-width:900px){.timeline-band div:last-child:nth-child(odd){grid-column:auto}}
.timeline-band b{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:1.6rem;line-height:1}
.timeline-band span{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}

/* ---------- Reveal ---------- */
html.js .rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity 900ms var(--ease-out),transform 900ms var(--ease-out)}
html.js .rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
html.js .rv-img{clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0);transition:clip-path 1100ms var(--ease-in-out)}
html.js .rv-img.in{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  html.js .rv,html.js .lines .ln>span{transform:none!important;filter:none!important;transition:opacity 300ms ease!important}
  html.js .rv-img{clip-path:none!important}
  .marquee .track{animation:none}
  .hero .bg img{transform:none!important;transition:none}
  .quote{transform:none;filter:none}
  .sheet{transition:opacity 200ms ease,visibility 0s;transform:none;opacity:0}
  .sheet.open{opacity:1}
  .veil{display:none}
  .media img{transition:none}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-transparency:reduce){
  .header::before,.dropdown,.quick,.glass,.factbar,.clock{-webkit-backdrop-filter:none;backdrop-filter:none}
  .header::before{background:var(--sand-50)}
  .quick,.factbar{background:var(--night-2)}
}

/* ---------- Contact-to-book band ---------- */
.book{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px;max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto}
@media (min-width:860px){.book{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.bcard{display:grid;gap:8px;align-content:start;padding:28px;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);background:var(--sand-50);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 50px 100px -50px rgba(17,13,12,.55);transition:transform 200ms var(--ease-out)}
.bcard:active{transform:scale(.98)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.bcard:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}.bcard:hover .go svg{transform:translateX(3px)}}
.bcard .ic{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(200,100,44,.12);color:var(--copper);margin-bottom:14px}
.bcard .ic svg{width:21px;height:21px}
.bcard .k{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.bcard b{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(1.2rem,1.7vw,1.5rem);line-height:1.15;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.bcard .go{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:14px;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--copper-deep)}
.bcard .go svg{width:15px;height:15px;transition:transform 200ms var(--ease-out)}
.book-note{text-align:center;margin:28px auto 0;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink-2)}
.book-note a{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.lang{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;height:36px;min-width:40px;padding:0 10px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(251,246,238,.24);font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;font-weight:500;transition:border-color 300ms ease}
.header.scrolled .lang{border-color:var(--line)}
.hero-book{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px 28px;padding:18px 18px 18px 24px;border-radius:var(--radius);background:rgba(28,19,20,.5);border:1px solid rgba(251,246,238,.14);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(150%);backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(150%)}
.hero-book .sunrow{display:flex;gap:28px}
.hero-book .sunrow div{display:grid;gap:2px}
.hero-book .k{font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(251,246,238,.56)}
.hero-book .v{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:22px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.1}
.hero-book p{margin:0;flex:1 1 280px;font-size:15px;color:rgba(251,246,238,.8)}
.hero-book .acts{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.brand{align-items:center}
.brand>span:not(.logo){display:inline-flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px}
.brand .logo{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cream);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(42,29,20,.08);flex:none;overflow:hidden}
.brand .logo img{width:36px;height:36px;object-fit:contain}
.brand .logo img.failed{display:none}
@media (max-width:420px){.brand>span:not(.logo){font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.1em}.brand>span small{display:none}}
.foot-logo{width:84px;height:84px;object-fit:contain;margin-bottom:28px}
.foot-logo.failed{display:none}
.loader-logo{position:absolute;left:50%;top:calc(50% - 110px);width:72px;height:72px;object-fit:contain;transform:translateX(-50%)}
.loader-logo.failed{display:none}
.mapcard{margin:0;padding:14px;border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--cream);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(42,29,20,.05);display:grid;gap:12px}
.mapcard img{width:100%;max-height:640px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:12px;background:var(--sand-200)}
.mapcard figcaption{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);padding:0 4px 4px}
.hero-in{width:100%}
.clock .ph{white-space:nowrap}

@media (max-width:600px){

  .display{font-size:clamp(3rem,15vw,4.6rem);letter-spacing:-.03em}

@media (max-width:380px){
  .brand>span:not(.logo){font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.08em}

}
@media (prefers-contrast:more){
  .quick,.hero-book,.factbar,.glass,.header::before{background:var(--night-2);-webkit-backdrop-filter:none;backdrop-filter:none}
  .lede,.prose p{color:var(--ink)}

/* ---------- Header v2: one line at every width, nothing cut ---------- */
.header-in{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px}
.header-in .brand{flex:none}
.header-in .nav{flex:1 1 auto;justify-content:center;min-width:0}
.header-right{flex:none;margin-inline-start:auto}
.nav-link{white-space:nowrap;padding:0 11px}
.nav{display:none}
@media (min-width:1320px){.nav{display:flex}.burger{display:none}}
@media (max-width:1319.98px){.burger{display:inline-grid}}
.clock{display:none}
@media (min-width:1640px){.clock{display:inline-flex}}
@media (min-width:1320px) and (max-width:1500px){.brand>span:not(.logo) small{display:none}.nav-link{padding:0 9px;font-size:13.5px}}
.lang{display:none}
.langs{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:40px;padding:3px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(251,246,238,.24);transition:border-color 300ms ease}
.header.scrolled .langs{border-color:var(--line)}
.langs a{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:38px;height:32px;padding:0 9px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;font-weight:500;opacity:.8;transition:background-color 200ms ease,color 200ms ease,opacity 200ms ease}
.langs a[lang="ar"]{font-family:"IBM Plex Sans Arabic",var(--f-body);letter-spacing:0;font-size:13.5px}

.langs-sheet{border-color:var(--line-dark);justify-self:start}
.langs-sheet a{min-width:52px;height:40px;font-size:14px}

/* ---------- Footer scene: the gate at sunset ---------- */
.giant{padding:0;margin:0}
.giant::before{display:none}
.foot-scene{position:relative;height:clamp(380px,52vw,820px);margin-top:clamp(8px,2vw,24px);overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;
  -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0%,#000 30%);mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0%,#000 30%)}
.scene-img{position:absolute;inset:-6% 0 0;z-index:-2;will-change:transform}
